definitions.gloss: gym clothes; PE uniform; sportswear (for school PE)
definitions.explanation: The clothing students change into for physical education ({体育|たいいく}) class at Japanese schools, typically a T-shirt and shorts or a tracksuit.

examples.japanese: {体育着|たいいくぎ}に{着替|きが}える。
examples.english: I change into my gym clothes.

examples.japanese: {体育着|たいいくぎ}を{家|いえ}に{忘|わす}れてきた。
examples.english: I left my gym clothes at home.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}の{前|まえ}に、みんなで{体育着|たいいくぎ}に{着替|きが}えて{校庭|こうてい}に{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Before PE class, we all changed into our gym clothes and gathered on the school grounds.

notes:
{体育着|たいいくぎ} is the gym uniform Japanese students wear for {体育|たいいく} (physical education). The {着|ぎ} suffix (a voiced form of {着|き}) means 'clothing for ~.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体育着|たいいくぎ}に{着替|きが}える: to change into gym clothes
- {体育着|たいいくぎ}{袋|ぶくろ}: gym-clothes bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体操着|たいそうぎ}: gym clothes — a near-synonym, used interchangeably in many schools
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}: sportswear — more general athletic clothing
